data.title: Kyobo Securities Details KRW 9.95 Billion Equity-Linked Derivative Bond Offering
data.description:
Kyobo Securities Co., Ltd ( (KR:030610) ) has shared an announcement.

Kyobo Securities is a securities company acting as issuer and calculation agent for equity-linked derivative bonds. Series 12902 is linked to the KOSPI200 Index and Samsung Electronics common shares.

The release details a KRW 9.95 billion public offering of 1 million securities at KRW 9,950 each, with subscriptions and payment scheduled for December 11, 2026, and maturity on December 13, 2029. Subscriptions are limited to trust customers of Suhyup Bank, and the securities are unlisted and not protected deposits; investors face issuer credit, principal-loss and limited early-liquidity risks.

data.title: Want Want Reports Lower Interim Revenue and Profit
data.description:
An update from Want Want China Holdings ( (HK:0151) ) is now available.

Want Want China Holdings reported unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 September 2026. Revenue fell 9.7% year on year to RMB10.026 billion, while gross profit declined 12.6% to RMB4.483 billion and operating profit dropped 38.3% to RMB1.394 billion.

Profit attributable to equity holders decreased 39.9% to RMB1.033 billion, with basic and diluted earnings per share falling to 8.77 RMB cents from 14.55 RMB cents. Gross margin narrowed to 44.7% from 46.2%, operating margin to 13.9% from 20.4%, and attributable profit margin to 10.3% from 15.5%.

data.title: HSBC Announces Results of $1.5 Billion Securities Tender Offer
data.description:
An announcement from HSBC Holdings ( (GB:HSBA) ) is now available.

HSBC Holdings plc announced on 20 November 2026 the results of its cash offer to purchase up to $1,500,000,000 of its outstanding $3,000,000,000 6.000% perpetual subordinated contingent convertible securities. The offer expired on 19 November 2026, with accepted securities priced at 100.50% of principal amount.

Holders tendered $1,570,766,000, exceeding the maximum, so HSBC accepted $1,500,000,000 on a 93.27884% prorated basis; total consideration was $1,507,500,000, excluding accrued interest. HSBC also confirmed that its $1,500,000,000 offering of 7.625% perpetual subordinated contingent convertible securities closed on 13 November 2026, satisfying the offer’s New Issue Condition.

data.title: Locate Technologies Reports First Quarterly Net Profit, Locate2u Revenue Up 72%
data.description:
Locate Technologies Limited ( (NZ:LOC) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Locate Technologies is an AI-powered delivery and logistics technology company operating Locate2u, an international route optimisation and delivery management platform, and Zoom2u, an Australian on-demand courier and delivery marketplace. In unaudited Q1 FY27 results, Locate2u revenue rose 72% year on year to NZ$1.50 million and accounted for 67% of Group revenue; the Group also recorded a NZ$62,000 net profit, its first quarterly net profit as a listed company.

The company advised that its 2026 annual meeting would be held virtually on 23 November 2026 and that the meeting materials contained no material information not previously released. Management also said the PURE debt facility had been refinanced in November and that large enterprise customer rollouts were underway.

data.title: Downer awarded approximately $1.1bn NSW transmission contract
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Downer EDI Limited ( (AU:DOW) ).

Downer EDI Limited provides integrated services across Australia and New Zealand, delivering and maintaining infrastructure in sectors including power, energy networks, roads, rail, water, telecommunications, defence and government services. Its market focus includes the energy transition, defence capability, government services, infrastructure expansion and local industry revitalisation.

Downer has been awarded by EnergyCo a contract to work with Transgrid on NSW’s Hunter Transmission Project, valued at approximately $1.1 billion over three years. The scope covers about 110 kilometres of new double-circuit 500kV transmission line; planning is expected to begin in December 2026, with mobilisation in 2027 subject to approvals. The project is intended to increase renewable capacity, reduce network constraints and support coal-fired power-station retirements.
